practice.name: Psych-Therapies
practice.description: Clinical psychologists offering assessment and therapy for children, young people, adults and older adults in Loughborough, Nottingham and online.
practice.places: Loughborough, Nottingham, and by video or telephone
practice.registration: All our psychologists are registered with the Health and Care Professions Council (HCPC) and are members of the British Psychological Society (BPS).
practice.businessDetails: [Trading name / company name and registered address]
practice.cancellation: Please give at least 24 hours' notice if you need to cancel or rearrange. Missed appointments without notice are charged at the full rate.

crisis.title: Need help now?
crisis.text: We are not an emergency service and cannot respond to urgent messages. If you are in crisis or worried about your safety, please call 999 or go to A&E. For urgent mental health support, call NHS 111 and choose the mental health option, or call Samaritans free on 116 123, day or night.

hero.hint: Hover over or select a word to learn what it is and what can help · Scroll down to explore

how.intro: A warm, non-judgemental space to talk, and evidence-based therapy to help you move towards a more meaningful life.

stats.label: usual wait for a first assessment

steps.title: Send a confidential enquiry
steps.text: You can refer yourself. You don't need a referral from your GP.

steps.title: We arrange your assessment
steps.text: Up to 60 minutes, in person or by video or telephone. A family member, partner or carer can join if you wish.

steps.title: A plan made together
steps.text: We agree the approach and an estimated number of sessions, and review progress as we go.
